# Dashboard browser assets

These pinned files are served by Flask so the dashboard and its browser tests work without CDN access. Asset versions match the former CDN references in `frontend/templates/index.html`.

| Library | Version | Source | License file |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| jQuery | 3.7.1 | https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.7.1.min.js | `jquery-LICENSE.txt` |
| Bootstrap CSS and bundle | 5.3.3 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/ | `bootstrap-LICENSE.txt` |
| DataTables core and Bootstrap 5 integration | 2.0.8 | https://cdn.datatables.net/2.0.8/ | `datatables-LICENSE.txt` |
| Chart.js UMD | 4.4.4 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.4/dist/chart.umd.min.js | `chartjs-LICENSE.md` |
